name: STOCKVEXA
tagline: Offline shop inventory, POS & GST billing
description: STOCKVEXA is an offline-first Android inventory and billing app for Indian shops — POS sell, products & categories, customers and suppliers, purchases, expenses, GST invoices with PDF and thermal print, UPI QR, WhatsApp bill share, party ledger, and Pro Google Drive backup. Built for shop-counter reality with PIN/partner/biometric lock and staff roles. Currently under development — coming soon on Google Play.
features: Offline-first POS / sell counter with live cart totals in ₹
Products, categories, stock levels and low-stock alerts
Customers & suppliers with photos, phone contacts and GSTIN
Expenses tracking for day-to-day shop costs
GST modes: Simple tax, CGST+SGST, and IGST
HSN/SAC per product with GSTR-ready summary reports
Invoices: edit, void (partner-lock), duplicate / credit notes
Cash + UPI split payment on checkout
PDF invoices and 58mm / 80mm thermal receipts (₹ font embed)
UPI QR on business profile + WhatsApp bill share
Notification bell: low stock, dues and backup tips
Local JSON backup & restore; Pro Google Drive sync + auto schedule
App PIN, partner lock, biometric unlock
Staff roles: Owner / Cashier / Viewer + audit CSV export
12 multicolor themes (Jade, Ocean, Orange, Slate and more)
Free tier with ads; STOCKVEXA Pro removes ads and unlocks Drive backup
